title: Multiplicity and Uniqueness of Equilibria in Continuous-Time Dynamic Discrete Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.33660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider multiplicity and uniqueness of equilibria in continuous-time dynamic discrete games where players move sequentially according to independent Poisson processes. With multiple equilibria, the structural model is incomplete: the reduced form and counterfactual predictions depend on how equilibria are selected. We provide closed-form sufficient conditions for uniqueness of Markov perfect equilibrium in this class of games. The conditions are semiparametric and can be verified from model primitives. To measure the coverage of the conditions and characterize multiplicity more broadly, we carry out a large-scale numerical search for equilibria of a dynamic duopoly model of entry and exit. Although uniqueness is the norm in our broad search, we find that multiplicity concentrates in economically relevant regions: where the market cannot profitably sustain both firms, where firms are very patient, and at intermediate decision frequenc

translated_title: 连续时间动态离散博弈中均衡的多重性与唯一性
translated_abstract: 我们研究连续时间动态离散博弈中均衡的多重性与唯一性问题，其中参与者按照独立的泊松过程依次行动。当存在多重均衡时，结构模型是不完备的：简化式和反事实预测将取决于均衡的选择方式。我们为这类博弈中马尔可夫完美均衡的唯一性提供了闭式充分条件。这些条件是半参数化的，可以从模型的基本要素中加以验证。为了衡量这些条件的覆盖范围并更广泛地刻画多重性，我们对一个关于进入与退出的动态双寡头模型的均衡进行了大规模数值搜索。尽管在我们的广泛搜索中均衡唯一性是常态，但我们发现多重性集中在具有经济意义的区域：市场无法让两家企业均维持盈利的情形、企业非常有耐心的情形，以及中等决策频率的情形。
tldr: 该论文为连续时间动态离散博弈中马尔可夫完美均衡的唯一性提供了可由模型基本要素验证的闭式半参数充分条件，并通过大规模数值搜索发现多重均衡虽属少数，但集中在市场难以支撑两家企业、企业非常耐心以及中等决策频率等经济上重要的区域。
en_tdlr: This paper provides closed-form semiparametric sufficient conditions for the uniqueness of Markov perfect equilibrium in continuous-time dynamic discrete games, verifiable from model primitives, and shows through large-scale numerical search that although uniqueness is the norm, multiplicity concentrates in economically relevant regions where the market cannot profitably sustain both firms, firms are very patient, or decision frequencies are intermediate.
